name: Patient Registration Agent
firstMessage: Hi, thanks for calling! I can help you register as a new patient today. First, could I get your phone number?

idleMessages: Take your time - I'm here whenever you're ready.

function.name: find_patient
function.description: Looks up an existing patient by phone number, to detect returning callers before registering a new person.

phone.description: The caller's phone number, in whatever format they said it.

function.name: submit_patient
function.description: Validates and optionally saves patient registration data. Call with confirmed=false first to get normalized values and any field errors for read-back; call again with confirmed=true only after the caller verbally confirms.

fields.description: Patient fields collected so far. Pass values exactly as the caller said them (spoken dates, full state names, etc.) - the server normalizes them.

state.description: Full state name or abbreviation, as said.

confirmed.description: false to validate and get a read-back; true to actually save, only after the caller confirms out loud.

patient_id.description: Only include this if find_patient found an existing record and the caller wants to update it rather than register a new person.
